# DropSpace 1.2.1

<!-- update-summary: Fixes the music spectrum disappearing during playback or after resuming when the player uses multiple processes. General settings can reveal New File Relay and Devices & Sharing. Active features keep their page visible. The music window’s separate next-line preview is optional and starts off, and same-language lyrics omit the missing-translation notice. -->

## Since 1.2.0

- New File Relay and Devices & Sharing are hidden by default. Each has its own switch in General settings. An enabled relay folder or sharing feature keeps its page visible and disables the corresponding switch until all features on that page are off.
- Under Music lyrics settings, enable **Show the next lyric separately in the music window** to see its dedicated next-line preview. It starts off. Full-page lyrics and the Island preview keep their existing behavior.
- The music window omits the missing-translation notice when the original lyrics already match the selected lyric translation language.

- Fixed an intermittent loss of the audio meter with multi-process players, including NetEase Cloud Music. Capture follows the player’s process tree even when its main window is hidden.
- The compact Island, expanded Island, Music page and independent music window retain an established meter during a temporary capture interruption. The bars settle to silence and resume moving when audio returns.

## Windows downloads

Windows x64 build 20348 or later. Choose the per-user installer, portable executable or MSIX package. The Windows packages are unsigned. SHA-256 checksums are included with the release. Portable updates use manual replacement.

v1.2.0 is the immediate upgrade baseline and previous Stable release.
